events.title: Google previews Gemini 4 Argon for long-horizon professional work
events.title_zh: Google 预览 Gemini 4 Argon 长时程工作能力
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon 的受控预览，首批仅向 Fairwind 计划中的可信网络防御团队开放。它把单次输出上限从 64K 提到 1M token，介绍价为每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，后续计划翻倍。Google 报告其在 DeepSWE v1.1、AutomationBench、长视频与网络安全任务上领先，但开发者 API 尚未开放。
events.summary_en: Google announced a controlled preview of Gemini 4 Argon, initially limited to trusted cyber defenders in the Fairwind Program. It raises the single-trajectory output limit from 64K to 1M tokens. Introductory pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 output, scheduled to double later. Google reports leading coding, workflow, long-video and cybersecurity results, but the developer API is not yet available.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对规划长时程 agent 的团队来说，1M 输出 token 把“能否持续执行”推到新的规模，但也放大成本、失控和审计压力。当前没有公开 API，先记录价格与边界；等开放后再用固定预算和人工审查测长轨迹。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams planning long-horizon agents, a 1M-token output ceiling expands execution depth while also magnifying cost, drift and audit pressure. There is no public API yet, so record the pricing and boundaries now and wait for access before running budgeted, human-reviewed trials.

technical_details.availability: trusted cyber defenders via Fairwind; broader API, enterprise and consumer access promised later
technical_details.controls: prompt-injection red teaming, chain-of-thought/action monitoring and hardened sandboxes

technical_details_zh.控制措施: 提示注入红队、思维链/动作监控与加固沙箱

events.title: cua-speedrun standardizes speed and cost tests for computer-use agents
events.title_zh: cua-speedrun 统一测试 computer-use agent 的速度与成本
events.summary_zh: cua-speedrun 提供统一虚拟机、执行流水线和 agent 接口，用同一基础设施比较四类 computer-use benchmark 的速度、成本与成功率。作者发现没有一个模型家族同时在三项指标上最优；更高 reasoning effort 有时反而更快，降低环境延迟也可能拖慢总完成时间。代码、基础设施和分析已公开。
events.summary_en: cua-speedrun provides a uniform virtual machine, execution pipeline and agent interface for comparing speed, cost and success across four computer-use benchmarks. The authors find no model family leads all three dimensions; higher reasoning effort can sometimes finish faster, and lower environment latency can increase total task time. Code, infrastructure and analysis are public.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估 computer-use agent 的团队来说，环境差异会把速度结论搅乱，单看任务成功率也会漏掉成本。这个公开基准适合在一天内校准自有评测环境，再决定路由与 reasoning effort。
events.why_it_matters_en: For computer-use agent evaluators, environment differences confound speed claims and success rate alone hides cost. The public harness can calibrate an internal evaluation environment within a day before setting routing and reasoning effort.

technical_details.controls: uniform VM and execution pipeline plus a shared agent interface
technical_details.dimensions: task success, wall-clock speed and cost
technical_details.findings: no single model family leads all dimensions; reasoning effort and environment latency interact non-monotonically
technical_details.artifact: public code, infrastructure and analysis at cuaspeedrun.com

events.next_action_en: Within one day, rerun 20 representative tasks with the public harness and check success, wall time and cost per task.

events.title: Ataraxos beats Stratego champions with damped self-play and search
events.title_zh: Ataraxos 用阻尼自博弈与搜索击败 Stratego 冠军
events.summary: Ataraxos combines dynamically damped self-play reinforcement learning with decision-time search for hidden-information games. It beat Pim Niemeijer 15–1 with four draws and went 38–2 at the 2025 Stratego World Championship. Training and belief-model code are public, but pretrained checkpoints are not.
events.why_it_matters: For researchers building simulator-backed planning agents, Ataraxos is evidence that training dynamics and search can reduce the data needed for large hidden-information games. Without checkpoints or an independent reproduction, the result is not yet a practical trial target.
events.summary_zh: Ataraxos 把动态阻尼自博弈强化学习与决策时搜索结合，用于大规模不完全信息游戏。它对 Pim Niemeijer 取得 15 胜 1 负 4 平，并在 2025 Stratego 世界锦标赛取得 38 胜 2 负。训练与 belief model 代码已公开，但没有预训练 checkpoint。
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对开发基于模拟器的规划 agent 的研究团队来说，Ataraxos 说明训练动态与搜索可以显著降低大型不完全信息游戏所需的数据量。没有 checkpoint 或独立复现前，它还不是可直接投入的试验对象。

technical_details.method: dynamically damped self-play RL plus decision-time search
technical_details.artifacts: MIT-licensed training and belief-model code; no pretrained checkpoint

technical_details_zh.方法: 动态阻尼自博弈强化学习 + 决策时搜索
technical_details_zh.世界锦标赛: 2025 Stratego 世界锦标赛 38 胜 2 负
technical_details_zh.效率主张: 训练样本少于 DeepNash 的 1/100；自博弈局数少于 1/30
technical_details_zh.公开材料: MIT 许可训练与 belief model 代码；无预训练 checkpoint

events.next_action_zh: 等预训练 checkpoint 或独立训练复现公开后，再评估它对隐藏信息规划任务的可迁移性。
events.next_action_en: Reassess transfer to hidden-information planning after pretrained checkpoints or an independent training reproduction appears.
